question.problem:
| $x$ | **$0$** | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $1$ | $3$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ |

The vector of coefficients  of the line $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x$ that best fits the data above can be found using linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?

current_example.problem:
| $x$ | **$-6$** | **$-3$** | **$-1$** | **$0$** | **$4$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-7$ | $-4$ | $2$ | $8$ | $10$ |

The vector of coefficients  of the line $y=\beta_0 + \beta_1 x$ that best fits the data above can be found using linear regression as 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14229230/assets/d7a54d94f699311d7faacf0d1776854262983b25ab66128e63edc76881fab4ce.svg)

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $\mathbf{y}$ is the observation vector. Which are the design matrix $X$ and the observation vector $\mathbf{y}$ in this context?
current_example.worked_solution:
| $x$ | **$\color{blue}-6$** | **$\color{blue}-3$** | **$\color{blue}-1$** | **$\color{blue}0$** | **$\color{blue}4$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $\color{red}-7$ | $\color{red}-4$ | $\color{red}2$ | $\color{red}8$ | $\color{red}10$ |

The coefficients of the line that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution ${\hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}}$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & -6 \\ 1 & -3 \\ 1 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ -4 \\ 2 \\ 8 \\ 10\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\boldsymbol{\beta}$ is the parameter vector, and $\mathbf{y}$ is the observation vector.
